newsitem.title: FRANCE: Callebaut sees strong E. European chocolate demand.
newsitem.headline: Callebaut sees strong E. European chocolate demand.

text.p: Benoit Villiers, Barry Callebaut's general manager for France, said on Tuesday that eastern European demand for chocolate products was expected to sharply increase by the year 2000.
"Consumption in eastern European countries is expected to grow from 550,000 tonnes in 1995 to 800,000 tonnes in the year 2000, that is a rise of over 45 percent," he told a news conference.
In Poland alone, where the group has a production plant, demand is expected to rise from 60,000 tonnes in 1995 to 90,000 tonnes in the year 2000, he said.
"There is a large potential for growth as annual per capita consumption in Poland is currently 1.6 kg while it stands at 6.4 kg in France and at 7.5 kg in Belgium," he said.
